## What changed

Describe the product, content, design, security, or infrastructure change.

## Why

State the user/problem outcome this change serves.

## Evidence

### Product / design

- [ ] Core states inspected in a real browser
- [ ] Mobile (390px-class) inspected
- [ ] Tablet inspected
- [ ] Desktop inspected
- [ ] Typography/RTL-LTR behavior inspected where relevant
- [ ] Before/after or final screenshots attached for material visual changes

### Source / content integrity

- [ ] Canonical refs resolve
- [ ] Source versions/provenance are explicit
- [ ] Third-party license/attribution checked
- [ ] Editorial claims have evidence refs
- [ ] Noahide normative guidance has the required review state
- [ ] Historical source text remains distinguishable from editorial prose

### Engineering

- [ ] Clean install succeeds
- [ ] Format/lint passes
- [ ] Typecheck passes
- [ ] Unit/component tests pass
- [ ] Production build passes
- [ ] Playwright core flows pass
- [ ] Accessibility/axe gate passes
- [ ] Visual regression reviewed
- [ ] Lighthouse/performance budget passes
- [ ] Dependency/security checks pass

## Security impact

Describe changes to external inputs, API/provider boundaries, rendering, auth/review actions, CSP/headers, dependencies, or public data exposure.

## Content/rabbinic impact

Describe whether the PR changes source material, explanatory prose, Noahide scope, review status, or public wording about authority/endorsement.

## Known limitations / follow-up

List deliberate exclusions or next work.

## Merge note

Leave the PR ready for human review. Do not self-merge as part of an autonomous build task.
